WITH lab_patient AS (
  SELECT l.ID, l.TAT, l.TAT2, p.SEX
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
patient_group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(CASE WHEN TAT IS NOT NULL AND TAT != 0 AND TAT2 IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(TAT2 AS REAL) / TAT ELSE NULL END) as avg_tat2_over_tat
  FROM lab_patient
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
sex_group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(avg_tat2_over_tat) as sex_group_average
  FROM patient_group_avgs
  WHERE avg_tat2_over_tat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY SEX
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(sex_group_average) as overall_average
  FROM sex_group_avgs
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    s.SEX,
    s.sex_group_average,
    s.sex_group_average - o.overall_average as diff
  FROM sex_group_avgs s
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sex_group_average > o.overall_average
)
SELECT 
  SEX,
  sex_group_average,
  diff
FROM final_result
ORDER BY SEX
